name: Tekst
description:
Bring Tekst directly into Claude.

Access your customer operations data without switching tools. Explore automation workflows, investigate failed runs to understand exactly where a process broke down, and query your analytics data to uncover email volumes, trends, and team performance.

With Tekst MCP, you can identify bottlenecks across your business processes, inspect classification and extraction models, review connected integrations, and access relevant operational context. All from within Claude.

Tekst becomes a native part of your workflow while fully respecting your existing permissions, access controls, and security policies.

Requires a Tekst account with MCP enabled.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tekst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tekst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tekst.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tekst MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tekst lists 21 MCP tools, including describe_analytics_tables, get_action_schema, get_automation, get_automation_monitor, get_automation_run, get_condition_schema, get_integration, get_model, get_process_activities, get_process_graph, get_process_graph_paths, and get_process_totals.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tekst?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Tekst in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Tekst requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tekst is developed by Tekst. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
